paragraphs: Consensus Cloud Solutions, Inc., together with its subsidiaries ("Consensus Cloud Solutions", "Consensus", the "Company", "our", "us" or "we"), is a provider of secure information delivery services. With our most prominent brand eFax® established over twenty-five years ago, Consensus has now evolved the service platform from pure cloud Fax to efficient and secure information exchange featuring solutions for data extraction, comprehension and transformation, facilitating interoperability and process improvement. Consensus is committed to security and compliance in data exchange, and our scalable Software-as-a-Service ("SaaS") platform is particularly attractive to regulated industries like healthcare and healthcare technology, public sector, financial services, law, and education. We offer local phone numbers in 46 countries and/or territories, servicing approximately 703 thousand customers ranging from small businesses to large enterprises and the federal government. Each customer cohort has unique needs and engagement preferences, and our go-to-market and customer service offerings are adapted across this continuum to serve each appropriately. Our top 10 customers represent approximately $33 million or 9% of total revenues.

Over the past decade, Consensus has increasingly focused on larger commercial customers ("Corporate") and public sector customers. This shift occurred as enterprise data communication moved toward digitization and cloud-based solutions. Sales to these customers are made through e-commerce and direct interaction with a salesperson, and often involve specific pricing, multiple line subscriptions, API connections, and/or commercial grade security. Sales channels include e-commerce, direct sales and sales through or referred by channel and strategic partners.

Our Corporate business has grown from $170 million of revenue in 2021 to approximately $223 million of revenue in 2025, representing a 7% compound annual growth rate. We currently serve approximately 65 thousand Corporate customers, ranging from small/medium businesses to large enterprises and government agencies. Our sales are primarily made through direct interaction with a salesperson and involve specific pricing and customer features such as but not limited to multiple line subscriptions, API connections and enhanced security features.
We currently serve approximately 638 thousand small office/home office ("SoHo") online fax customers. Approximately 78% of our SoHo base have been customers for more than two years.

Healthcare represents Consensus' largest industry vertical and has information, secure communication, management and interoperability needs. In addition to the offerings discussed above, Consensus has several product offerings that are specific to the healthcare industry.

We believe our leadership in digital cloud fax, intelligent data extraction, HL7, FHIR and our deep domain knowledge and experience in the healthcare industry positions Consensus well to help healthcare providers accomplish their broader digitization and interoperability objectives.

Our focused strategy on achieving an industry leading security and compliance posture has been a critical driver of growth in our Corporate and healthcare-focused businesses over the past several years and we have strategically invested in people, processes, and tools to this effect. Our key accomplishments include becoming the first Health Information Trust Alliance ("HITRUST") certified digital cloud fax provider and the first Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program ("FedRAMP") authorized cloud fax provider. These efforts have made it possible for us to service the Public Sector and other heavily regulated industries.

eFax Corporate®: eFax Corporate® is a global online faxing service with customers worldwide. It provides digital cloud fax technology, enabling users to send, receive and manage faxes digitally through multiple user interfaces or seamlessly integrated in their application through a robust API. In addition to eFax Corporate®, we offer corporate fax services under a variety of brands, including but not limited to MyFax®, Sfax®, and SRFax®.

ECFax®: ECFax® is comparable to eFax Corporate® in its features and use cases but is specifically developed for use by public sector customers with extremely high security demands. ECFax® is a SaaS offering authorized at the FedRAMP High Impact level operating in a government cloud environment.

eFax UniteTM: eFax UniteTM is a single platform that allows the user to choose between several protocols to send and receive healthcare information in an environment that can integrate into an existing electronic health record ("EHR") system or stand-alone if no EHR is present.

eFax Conductor: eFax Conductor is a robust interface engine and complete interoperability platform that provides seamless integration technology supporting the latest standards for connectivity and data formats (API/FHIR, HL7, Direct Secure Messaging, web services, message queues, etc.), addressing a wide range of interoperability challenges from the simple to the extremely complex.

eFax Clarity: Using Natural Language Processing and Artificial Intelligence ("NLP/AI"), the eFax Clarity platform can transform unstructured documents originating in fax transmissions, scans or other technologies into structured actionable data. eFax Clarity's intelligent data extraction allows data to be sent to the right person, at the right place, at the right time - to accelerate patient treatment across the continuum of care. Additionally, our pre-packaged applications of Clarity – Clarity Clinical Documentation™ and Clarity Prior Authorization™ – tackle specific data extraction challenges in the healthcare industry.

We also cater to individuals and small businesses with predefined subscriptions and e-commerce convenience through our small office/home office ("SoHo") online brands, including but not limited to eFax®, our global online faxing servicing customers worldwide, jSign®, MyFax®, SFax®, MetroFax®, SRFax® and multiple others.

Building on our position as a global provider of internet fax solutions from individuals to enterprises and across industries, Consensus is well positioned to capitalize on shifts in how we share private documents and information. headings: Risks Related To Regulation, Including Taxation
Risks Related To Our Common Stock
Our fax services constitute substantially all of our revenue and operating income.
Developments in the healthcare industry could adversely affect our business.

The market for our products and services is relatively new and rapidly evolving. If the market does not develop further, develops more slowly, or in a way that we do not expect, our business will be adversely affected.
There are particular challenges in addressing the market for healthcare interoperability solutions. If we do not successfully address these challenges, our business will be adversely affected.

Our industry is undergoing rapid technological changes, and we may not be able to keep up. If our products and services do not gain market acceptance, our operating results may be negatively affected.

We use artificial intelligence in our business, and challenges with properly managing its use could result in harm to our brand, reputation, business or customers, and adversely affect our results of operations.
We have made and expect to continue to make acquisitions and investments that could disrupt our operations and harm our operating results.
Pandemics or global health crises, and related governmental responses could negatively affect our business, operations and financial performance.
Our business could suffer if providers of broadband Internet access services block, impair or degrade our services.

Our business is dependent on a small number of telecommunications carriers in each region and our inability to maintain agreements at attractive rates with such carriers may negatively impact our business.
Our business could suffer if we cannot obtain or retain numbers, are prohibited from obtaining local numbers or are limited to distributing local numbers to only certain customers.
The successful operation of our business depends upon the supply of critical business elements from other companies.
Increased cost of email transmissions could have a material adverse effect on our business.
Our sales cycle with enterprise and commercial customers can be long and unpredictable, and our sales efforts require considerable time and expense.
A system failure, cybersecurity breach or other technological risk could delay or interrupt service to our customers, harm our reputation or subject us to significant liability.
Our growth will depend on our ability to develop, strengthen, and protect our brands, and these efforts may be costly and have varying degrees of success.
Inadequate intellectual property protections could prevent us from defending our proprietary technology and intellectual property.
We may be found to have infringed the intellectual property rights of others, which could expose us to substantial damages or restrict our operations.
We may be subject to risks from international operations.
We may be engaged in legal proceedings that could cause us to incur unforeseen expenses and could divert significant operational resources and our management's time and attention.
Our business is highly dependent on our billing systems.
Increased numbers of credit and debit card declines in our business could lead to a decrease in our revenues or rate of revenue growth.
paragraphs: Before deciding to invest in Consensus or to maintain or increase your investment, you should carefully consider the risks described below in addition to the other cautionary statements and risks described elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K and our other filings with the SEC, including our subsequent reports on Forms 10-Q and 8-K. The risks and uncertainties described below are not the only ones we face. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial also may affect our business. If any of these known or unknown risks or uncertainties actually occurs, our business, prospects, financial condition, operating results and cash flows could be materially adversely affected. In that event, the market price of our common stock will likely decline and you may lose part or all of your investment. The disclosures in this section reflect our beliefs and opinions as to factors that could materially and adversely affect us in the future. References to past events are provided by way of example only and are not intended to be a complete listing or a representation as to whether or not such factors have occurred in the past.
The following is a summary of the principal risks that could adversely affect our business, operations and financial results.
•Our fax services constitute substantially all of our revenue and operating income.
•Developments in the healthcare industry could adversely affect our business.

•The market for our products and services is rapidly evolving. If the market does not develop further, develops more slowly, or in a way that we do not expect, our business will be adversely affected.
•There are particular challenges in addressing the market for healthcare interoperability solutions.

We use the following metrics to generally assess the operational and financial performance of our business, including the growth of our business, the value provided by customers to our business and our customer retention that provide insights that contribute to certain of our business planning decisions. We believe these financial measures are useful to investors both because (1) they allow for greater transparency with respect to key metrics used by management in its financial and operational decision-making and (2) they are used by our institutional investors and the analyst community to help them analyze the health of our business.

The following table sets forth certain key performance metrics for our operations for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023 (in thousands, except for percentages and Average Revenue per Customer Account):

In the second quarter of 2025, we eliminated dormant accounts not contributing to revenue from the number of SoHo customer accounts. The prior year periods have been revised for consistency with the current year, and all metrics calculated based on the number of customer accounts (including ARPA and Monthly Churn %) are calculated based on the revised numbers. (2)Represents a monthly ARPA for the year, calculated as follows: monthly ARPA on an annual basis is calculated by dividing revenue for the year by the average customer base for the applicable period and dividing that amount by 12 months. We believe ARPA provides investors an understanding of the average monthly revenues we recognize per account associated within Consensus' customer base. As ARPA varies based on fixed subscription fee and variable usage components, we believe it can serve as a measure by which investors can evaluate trends in the types of services, levels of services and the usage levels of those services across Consensus' customers.
(3)Paid Adds represents paying new Consensus customer accounts added during the annual period.

(4)Monthly churn represents paid monthly Corporate and SoHo customer accounts that were cancelled during each month of the annual period, divided by the average number of customers during each month of the same annual period (including the paid adds). The period measured is annual and expressed as a monthly churn rate over the annual period.

We prepare our consolidated financial statements and related disclosures in accordance with U.S. generally accepted accounting principles ("GAAP") and our discussion and analysis of our financial condition and operating results requires us to make judgments, assumptions and estimates that affect the amounts reported in our consolidated financial statements and accompanying notes. See Note 2 - Basis of Presentation and Summary of Significant Accounting Policies of the Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements in Part II, Item 8 of this Form 10-K, which describes the significant accounting policies and methods used in the preparation of our consolidated financial statements. We base our estimates on historical experience and on various other assumptions we believe to be reasonable under the circumstances, the results of which form the basis for making judgments about the carrying value of assets and liabilities. Actual results may differ significantly from those estimates under different assumptions and conditions and may be material.

We believe that our most critical accounting policies are those related to revenue recognition, internal-use software development costs, share-based compensation expense, income taxes and tax contingencies. We consider these policies critical because they are those that are most important to the portrayal of our financial condition and results and require management's most difficult, subjective and complex judgments, often as a result of the need to make estimates about the effect of matters that are inherently uncertain. Senior management has reviewed these critical accounting policies and related disclosures with the Audit Committee of the Company's Board of Directors.

We earn revenue from contracts with customers, primarily through the provision of cloud-based communication and digital signature solutions that allow customers to access our software without taking possession. The contracts include both recurring subscription and usage-based fees, and the total transaction price is allocated to performance obligations in each contract as appropriate. Revenue for cloud-based services is recognized over time in the period earned. The contracts may be terminated early. Fees collected in advance are non-refundable, and they are deferred and recognized in revenue when the related performance obligations are satisfied. Standard Corporate contracts billed monthly include a termination charge equal to the minimum fees payable through the last day of the contract term.

paragraphs: Consensus Cloud Solutions, Inc., 連同其子公司("Consensus Cloud Solutions", "Consensus", "本公司", "我們", "我們的"或"我們")，為提供安全資訊傳遞服務的公司。我們最知名的品牌 eFax® 自二十多年前建立以來，Consensus 已將服務平台從純雲端傳真進化為高效且安全的資訊交換服務，提供資料抽取、理解與轉換的解決方案，促進互通性與流程改善。Consensus 對資料交換的保安與合規性有著承諾，我們的可擴展軟體即服務("SaaS") 平台特別受到醫療保健與醫療科技、公共部門、金融服務、法律與教育等受規範產業的青睞。我們在 46 個國家及/或地區提供本地電話號碼，服務約 703 千位客戶，從小型企業到大型企業與聯邦政府。每個客戶羣體都有獨特的需求與參與偏好，我們的市場推廣與客戶服務方案根據此連續體進行調整，以適切服務每個羣體。我們的前十大客戶代表約 33 百萬美元或總營收的 9%。
過去十年，Consensus 越來越多地專注於大型企業客戶("Corporate")與公共部門客戶。這種轉變發生在企業資料通訊朝向數位化與雲端解決方案發展的同時。這些客戶的銷售透過電商與銷售人員的直接互動進行，通常涉及特定價格、多線訂閱、API 連接與/或商業等級的安全性。銷售通路包括電商、直接銷售與透過或由通路與戰略夥伴進行或推薦的銷售。
我們的 Corporate 事業已從 2021 年的 170 百萬美元營收成長至 2025 年的約 223 百萬美元營收，代表 7% 的年複合成長率。我們目前服務約 65 千位 Corporate 客戶，從小型/中型企業到大型企業與政府機構。我們的銷售主要透過銷售人員的直接互動進行，並涉及特定價格與客戶功能，例如但不僅限於多線訂閱、API 連接與增強的安全功能。
我們目前服務約 638 千位小型辦公室/家庭辦公室("SoHo") 線上傳真客戶。我們 SoHo 基礎大約 78% 的客戶已服務超過兩年。
醫療保健代表 Consensus 最大的產業垂直領域，並有資訊、安全通訊、管理與互通性需求。除了上述的產品與服務外，Consensus 還有幾項專門針對醫療保健產業的產品與服務。
我們相信我們在數位雲端傳真、智慧資料抽取、HL7、FHIR 以及我們在醫療保健產業的深厚領域知識與經驗，使 Consensus 能夠協助醫療保健提供者達成更廣泛的數位化與互通性目標。

我們專注於實現產業領先的保安與合規性姿態的策略，是過去幾年我們 Corporate 事業與醫療保健導向事業成長的關鍵驅動力。我們已戰略性地投資於人力、流程與工具以達成此目標。我們的關鍵成就包括成為首個 Health Information Trust Alliance("HITRUST") 認證的數位雲端傳真供應商，以及首個 Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program("FedRAMP") 許可的雲端傳真供應商。這些努力使我們得以服務公共部門與其他高度受規範的產業。
eFax Corporate®: eFax Corporate® 是一項全球線上傳真服務，擁有全球客戶。它提供數位雲端傳真技術，使使用者能透過多種使用者介面數位發送、接收與管理傳真，或透過強大的 API 無縫整合至其應用程式中。除了 eFax Corporate®，我們還在多種品牌下提供企業傳真服務，包括但不僅限於 MyFax®、Sfax® 和 SRFax®。
ECFax®: ECFax® 在功能與使用情境上與 eFax Corporate® 相似，但專門為具極高安全需求的公部門客戶所開發。ECFax® 是一個 SaaS 服務，已獲美國聯邦風險與授權管理計畫（FedRAMP）高影響級別認證，運作於政府雲端環境。
eFax UniteTM: eFax UniteTM 是一個單一平台，讓使用者可選擇多種協議來傳送與接收醫療資訊，並可在已有的電子病歷（"EHR"）系統中整合使用，或在無 EHR 的情況下獨立運作。
eFax Conductor: eFax Conductor 是一個強大且完整的介面引擎與互通性平台，提供無縫整合技術，支援最新的連線標準與資料格式（API/FHIR、HL7、Direct Secure Messaging、Web 服務、訊息佇列等），解決從簡單到極其複雜的互通性挑戰。

eFax Clarity: 藉由自然語言處理與人工智慧（"NLP/AI"），eFax Clarity 平台可將來自傳真、掃描或其他技術的非結構化文件轉換為結構化且可操作的資料。eFax Clarity 的智慧資料抽取功能，可讓資料在正確的時間、正確的地點，傳送到正確的人，以加速患者在照護連續體中的治療。此外，我們預先包裝的 Clarity 應用程式 – Clarity Clinical Documentation™ 與 Clarity Prior Authorization™ – 針對醫療產業的特定資料抽取挑戰提供解決方案。
我們也透過小辦公室/家庭辦公室（"SoHo"）線上品牌，為個人與小型企業提供預設訂閱與電子商務便利性，包括但不限於 eFax®，我們的全球線上傳真服務，為全球客戶提供服務，jSign®、MyFax®、SFax®、MetroFax®、SRFax® 與多個其他品牌。

paragraphs: 除歷史資訊外，以下管理層討論與分析財務狀況及營運結果之段落包含前瞻性陳述。這些前瞻性陳述涉及風險、不確定性與假設。實際結果可能與這些前瞻性陳述所預期的有重大差異，原因包括但不限於在本年度報告表 10-K 第 I 部分，第 1A 項「風險因素」中所討論的各項因素。讀者應謹慎勿過度依賴這些前瞻性陳述，這些陳述僅反映管理層於本文件出具日的意見。本公司不負有義務修正或公開發佈任何對這些前瞻性陳述之修正結果，除非法律有此要求。讀者應謹慎審閱風險因素，以及在其他時間點向 SEC 提交的文件中所載的風險因素。

Consensus 是提供安全資訊傳遞服務的領導廠商。自二十多年前建立我們最知名的品牌 eFax® 以來，Consensus 已將服務平台從純雲端傳真演進為高效能且安全的資訊交換服務，提供資料抽取、理解與轉換的解決方案，促進系統間的互通性與流程改善。Consensus 對資料交換的保安與合規性有著承諾，我們可擴展的軟體即服務（"SaaS"）平台尤其受到醫療保健與醫療科技、公共部門、金融服務、法律與教育等受規範產業的青睞。我們在 46 個國家及地區提供本地電話號碼，服務約 703 千位客戶，從小型企業到大型企業與聯邦政府皆有。每個客戶羣體都有獨特的需求與參與偏好，我們的市場進入策略與客戶服務方案會根據此連續體進行調整，以適應各個羣體。我們的前十大客戶約佔總營業收入的 9%，金額為 32.7 百萬美元。
過去十年，Consensus 越來越專注於大型企業客戶（"Corporate"）與公共部門客戶。此轉變發生在企業資料通訊朝向數位化與雲端解決方案發展的同時。這些客戶的銷售是透過電商與銷售人員直接互動進行，且通常涉及特定價格、多線訂閱、API 連接與/或商業等級的安全性。銷售通路包括電商、直接銷售與透過或推薦由通路與戰略夥伴進行的銷售。
我們使用以下指標來一般性評估我們業務的營運與財務表現，包括我們業務的成長、客戶對我們業務的價值以及我們的客戶留存率，這些資訊有助於我們的業務規劃決策。我們認為這些財務指標對投資者而言是有用的，原因在於（1）這些指標能提供更大的透明度，以反映管理層在財務與營運決策中所使用的關鍵指標；（2）這些指標被我們的機構投資者與分析師社羣用來幫助他們分析我們業務的健康狀況。
以下表格列示我們業務在 2025 年 12 月 31 日、2024 年 12 月 31 日及 2023 年 12 月 31 日的某些關鍵績效指標（單位為千美元，除百分比與平均每客戶帳戶收入外）：

3.03 % 2.36 % 1.49 % 3.64 % 3.56 % 3.66 % 3.59 % 3.48 % 3.54 % (1)Consensus 的客戶被定義為付款的企業客戶與 SoHo 客戶帳戶。在 2025 年第二季，我們從 SoHo 客戶帳戶數中剔除了未活動且未產生收入的帳戶。前一年期間已根據當前年份進行調整，所有以客戶帳戶數計算的指標（包括 ARPA 與每月流失率 %）均根據調整後的數字計算。由於此變更，2024 年與 2023 年的 SoHo 客戶帳戶數分別減少 26 千與 22 千。
(2) 代表年度每月平均 ARPA，計算方式如下：年度每月 ARPA 是以年度營業收入除以適用期間的平均客戶數，再除以 12 個月。我們認為 ARPA 可讓投資人瞭解與 Consensus 顧客基礎相關的每個帳戶平均每月收入。由於 ARPA 會根據固定訂閱費與變動使用零組件而有所差異，我們認為它可以用來作為投資人評估 Consensus 顧客所使用服務類型、服務層級及使用程度趨勢的指標。
(3) 已付款新增代表年度期間內新增的已付款 Consensus 顧客帳戶數。
(4) 每月流失率代表年度期間內每個月取消的已付款 Corporate 和 SoHo 顧客帳戶數，除以相同年度期間每個月的平均客戶數（包含已付款新增）。所測量的期間為年度，並以年度期間內的每月流失率表示。

我們依照美國通用會計準則（"GAAP"）編製合併財務報表及相關揭露，我們對財務狀況與營運結果的討論與分析需要做出判斷、假設與估計，這些會影響我們合併財務報表及附註中所報導的金額。請參閱本 Form 10-K 第二部分，第 8 項「財務報表附註」中「財務報表編製基礎及重要會計政策摘要」（Note 2 - Basis of Presentation and Summary of Significant Accounting Policies of the Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements in Part II, Item 8）所說明的重要會計政策與方法。我們的估計基於歷史經驗及其他我們認為在特定情況下合理的假設，這些結果成為我們對資產與負債帳面價值做出判斷的基礎。實際結果可能因不同假設與條件而顯著不同，並可能具有重大影響。
我們認為最重要的會計政策與收入確認、內部使用軟體開發成本、股票基於報酬費用、所得稅及稅務備抵項目相關。我們認為這些政策最重要，因為它們對我們財務狀況與結果的呈現至關重要，且需要管理階層做出最困難、主觀且複雜的判斷，往往因為需要估計某些本身具有不確定性的事項的影響所致。高階管理階層已審閱這些關鍵會計政策與相關揭露，並與本公司董事會審計委員會進行討論。

我們透過與客戶的契約賺取收入，主要透過提供雲端通訊與數位簽名解決方案，讓客戶能使用網路存取我們的軟體，而無需實際取得。這些契約包含定期訂閱費與使用基準費用，總交易價格會根據契約中的績效義務適當分配。雲端服務的收入會在取得期間內逐期確認。這些契約可能在到期前終止。預先收取的費用不可退款，並會遞延至相關績效義務履行時確認為收入。標準的企業契約每月計費包含終止費用，等於契約期間最後一天應支付的最低費用。

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險
與規範及稅務相關的風險
與我們普通股相關的風險
本公司之傳真服務佔營業收入及營運收入的絕大部份。
醫療產業的發展可能對本公司業務造成不利影響。
本公司產品與服務之市場相對新興且快速發展。若市場未能進一步發展、發展速度較慢，或發展方式與我們預期不同，將對本公司業務造成不利影響。
在處理醫療衛生互通解決方案市場時，面臨特定的挑戰。若我們未能成功應對這些挑戰，將會對本公司業務產生不利影響。
我們所處的產業正在經歷快速的技術變革，我們可能無法跟上這股變革。若我們的產品與服務未能獲得市場接受，將會對本公司營運結果產生負面影響。
我們的業務中運用人工智慧，若在正確管理其使用方面遇到困難，可能會對本公司品牌、聲譽、業務或客戶造成損害，並對本公司營運結果產生不利影響。
我們已進行並預期將持續進行收購與投資，這些行動可能會干擾本公司營運，並對營運結果造成損害。
疫情或全球衛生危機，以及相關政府的應對措施，可能會對本公司業務、營運及財務表現產生負面影響。
若寬頻互聯網接入服務提供者阻礙、影響或降低我們的服務品質，將會對本公司業務造成損害。
本公司業務依賴每個地區為數量不多的電信業者，若無法與這些電信業者維持具有吸引力的費用協議，可能會對本公司業務產生負面影響。
若我們無法取得或保留號碼、被禁止取得當地號碼，或僅能將當地號碼分配給特定客戶，將會對本公司業務造成損害。
本公司業務之順利運作取決於其他公司所提供之關鍵業務要素。
電子郵件傳輸成本增加可能對本公司業務造成重大不利影響。
本公司與企業及商業客戶之銷售週期可能長且難以預測，且銷售業務需要大量時間與費用。
系統故障、網路安全事件或其他科技風險可能導致服務延誤或中斷，損害本公司聲譽或使本公司面臨重大賠償責任。
本公司之成長將取決於本公司發展、強化及保護品牌之能力，而這些努力可能成本高昂且成效不一。
智慧財產權保護不足可能使本公司無法防禦專有技術及智慧財產權。
本公司可能被認為侵權他人之智慧財產權，此可能使本公司面臨重大賠償或限制本公司營運。
本公司可能面臨國際業務之風險。
本公司可能涉及法律程序，此等程序可能導致本公司產生預期外之費用，並可能分散本公司運營資源及管理階層時間與注意力。
本公司業務高度依賴本公司之計費系統。
本公司業務中信用卡及提款卡交易遭拒絕之數量增加，可能導致本公司營業收入或收入成長率下降。
paragraphs: 在決定投資 Consensus 或維持或增加您的投資前，您應仔細考量下列所描述的風險，以及本年度報告表 10-K 其他處所提及的其他警示聲明與風險，以及我們向 SEC 提交的其他文件，包括我們之後的 10-Q 與 8-K 報告。下列所描述的風險與不確定性並非我們唯一面臨的風險。尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前我們尚未知悉或認為不重要，也可能影響我們的業務。若任何已知或未知的風險或不確定性實際發生，將可能對我們的業務、前景、財務狀況、營運成果與現金流造成重大不利影響。在此情況下，我們的普通股市場價格將可能下跌，您可能損失部分或全部投資。本節的揭露反映我們對未來可能對我們造成重大不利影響因素的信念與意見。提及過去事件僅為範例，並非完整列出或表示這些因素是否已發生在過去。
以下為可能對我們的業務、營運與財務結果造成不利影響的主要風險摘要。
•我們的傳真服務佔據我們營業收入與營運收入的絕大多數。
•醫療產業的發展可能對我們的業務造成不利影響。
•我們產品與服務的市場快速演進。若市場未能進一步發展、發展速度較慢，或以我們預期以外的方式發展，將對我們的業務造成不利影響。
•在醫療產業互通解決方案市場面臨特定挑戰。
